_doc: Cline (VS Code extension): open the MCP Servers icon, go to the Configure tab, click Configure MCP Servers, and paste the emem entry under mcpServers. The Cline CLI reads ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json. Keep "type": "streamableHttp": without it Cline uses the legacy SSE transport, and https://emem.dev/mcp accepts only POST (Streamable HTTP).
